listing.summary: A different, more hardcore take on Diable Avionics, with tighter combat balance, roster-wide viability, additional polish, and a few tentative story additions.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a hardcore variant of the Diable Avionics faction with tighter combat balance and new story content.

description:
FlashFrozen's original thread

Tartiflette's thread

A different, more hardcore take on Diable Avionics, with tighter combat balance, roster-wide viability, additional polish, and a few tentative story additions.

Always DELETE the old version before extracting the new one
Requires LazyLib and MagicLib
Not save compatible with other Diable forks, can be Added Mid-save.

Having problems running mods?  Visit the Mod Troubleshooting Guide!

Claiming ownership over millions of people's possessions might seem like a bold claim, but that is one the Diable Avionics Corporation intends to enforce, with deadly means if necessary.

GAMEPLAY

The Diable Avionics Corporation plays similarly to Mid-tech: they use their superior mobility to choose their engagements and overwhelm isolated targets. The subtility they add is that their ships are generally individually slightly inferior to Vanilla ones, but synergize very well with their wings of Wanzers: mech-like strike-crafts that pack a superior punch but susceptible to enemy fire. To help them carry their missions, most ships tend to saturate the enemy's PD with swarms of micro-missiles.

A typical successful engagement against Diable Avionics' fleets generally requires a solid phalanx of anti-fighter weapons to break the initial Wanzer and missile waves and a decisive counter-strike while their carriers are still rebuilding their strike-craft support.

THE SPIRIT OF THIS FORK

This fork aims to juice every ounce of fun out of what was already inside Flashfrozen and Tartiflette’s Diable.
We aim to perfect the balance for today’s Starsector, polish the gameplay, animations, VFX, and AI behavior where needed, and add even more depth to an amazing mod and its world.

Our first goal is to make every piece of the already huge roster viable within the Diable doctrine before even thinking of adding new ships. Every addition will be carefully considered.
As the game evolves, some changes may become necessary. Any changes we do make will come from a place of deep appreciation for what the mod is and the vision it carries.
Every new balance or gameplay change will be playtested by a team of combat veterans and casuals alike before release. Those changes will be documented in detailed patch notes, with tips and explanations for players.

Features advanced transforming ships:

SCREENSHOTS

(Click to enlarge)

Spoiler

Versant Teaser:

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
What is the difference between this fork and the other one

The roster is more tightly curated, with less overlap between ships, it sticks to Tart's designs.
Key hulls, weapons and systems have received balance passes to fit today's starsector but fit the "Original Flavor".

Lots of AI improvements peppered through the entire mod. New music and visuals for quest content.
Extra paintjobs and optional cosmetic hullmods and lunalib settings.
We raised both the skill ceiling and the power ceiling on some points by rewarding combined-arms play and Wanzer coordination, and since strong generalists ship addons don't exist in this fork, you might need to change your strategies more.

In return, the original diable ships, weapons, and wanzers are balanced differently.
There are no "catch-all" ships or power picks that compensate for poor fleet composition.
We've also added a bit of new handcrafted story content beyond combat and a very special reward too. You get a lategame quest with new area for a new quest that will lead you to a unique boss after you get one of diable's unique ships. The Last Line fight is also turned into a proper boss fight, among other things.

Is this fork more difficult?

It is a smidge more hardcore. We’re two combat oriented players who love Diable, and we balance around deliberate fleet building and combat decisions.
There are no filler ships or universal power picks that erase the consequences of bad tactics or a weak fleet composition. Expect mistakes to be punished and Diable ships to perform best when supporting each other and their Wanzers.
But also expect far more tactical options across the entire roster. The skill and power ceilings are both high, rewarding creative players who experiment. In the spirit of the original mod, nothing is free and you’ll have to figure out for yourself how to reach them.
Everything is viable now, it's how you use it.

What is this fork based on?

This project is based on a mix of PMD’s and Tartiflette’s last patches. It does not use content from any other fork.

Can I use this alongside another Diable fork?

No. Install only one Diable fork at a time. Always delete the old version completely before installing this one.

What new ships does your fork add ?

Our fork only has ships and wanzers made by Tartiflette.

I can't beat the mission, it's too hard !

Come prepared in the lategame, and listen to your XO during combat :)

What's with the name ? Who came up with it?

Credits:

Flashfrozen & Tartiflette  Original Diable Avionics mod creation, assets, codebase and 10 years of development.
After/Aero:Balance, Art/writing/concepts, Quest/environment/combat development, AI design(Grazer)
TIDAL: Balance, Coding QC, AI implementation (Grazer/Assume Control), Gulf hullmods

Spectros: Playtesting.
Tranquility: Fleetbuilder tweaks and implementation.
Zone51: Calm AI code and initial Coanda sprite modification.
Nia Tahl: Paintjobs.
Selkie: 4-large-mount Pandemonium sprite variant and paintjobs.
Crablobab: Jump code inspiration.

changelog.3.0.6:
“3.0.5 is Missing”
 SAVE COMPATIBLE
 A smaller follow-up focused on The Last Line’s campaign behavior, Gust piloting, and the remaining variant issues.
 Bugfixes
 Fixed the boss Virtuous missing a few capacitors.
 Fixed the final eight variants with unused OP. Hopefully, that’s all of them.
 Protected the Virtuous from dealer interactions and similar effects.
 Gust Family
 Assume Wing Control: The Wanzer directly controlled by the player now takes 20% less damage and gains 25% maneuverability, in addition to Assume Control’s existing 25% time-flow bonus.
 This only affects the single player-controlled Wanzer and has no fleet-wide effect.
 Fixed a rare bug where control failed to return to the carrier after the controlled Wanzer was destroyed.
 The Last Line
 Increased its Nexerelin autoresolve strength to better reflect its actual combat power.
 The Last Line now retreats to Sivie after losing the Virtuous to NPC fleets and returns after 30 days.
 If completely destroyed by NPCs, Sivie rebuilds the fleet after 30 days.
 Lost escorts are replenished if the Virtuous survives.
 NPC battles cannot generate a recoverable Virtuous wreck.
 Support pauses while Sivie is outside Diable control and resumes if the system is reclaimed.
 Player Interactions
 Escort losses persist for 10 days if the player retreats without destroying the Virtuous.
 Peacefully claiming the Virtuous cancels Save the Children.
 If NPCs destroy The Last Line, the bounty becomes available again when the fleet returns.
 Existing unresolved encounters receive these changes automatically.
 After Claiming or Destroying the Virtuous
 After a peaceful simulation claim, the Maelstrom pilot takes command.
 After the player destroys the Virtuous, The Last Line returns with a Storm replacing it.
 Sivie continues maintaining The Last Line without restoring its Virtuous.
changelog.3.0.4:
The Last Line
 SAVE COMPATIBLE
 The Last Line
 Rebuilt from scratch as a handcrafted 240 DP boss fight, with fixed loadouts, officers, fleet skills, new simulation visuals, and dedicated music.
 Existing unresolved encounters migrate automatically. The classic procedural fleet remains available as an easier LunaLib option.
 Friendly players can face it in a 240 DP simulation and peacefully claim the Virtuous and a Maelstrom blueprint. The real fight has no deployment limit.
 Campaign & Missions
 Save the Children rewards: 125,000 → 1,250,000 credits and +5 → +15 reputation.
 Added the Diable station blueprint to Dead Frequency.
 Rebalanced the First Relay fight and improved its performance, hyperspace location, ambience, and combat music.
 Ships & Wanzers
 Maelstrom deployment cost: 42 → 43 DP.
 Gust wings no longer receive damage reduction from Assume Control.
 Raven PD buff revert: range 600 → 400, DPS 250 → 200, ammunition 9 → 6, and +25% damage against fighters and missiles removed.
 Valiant Ilis PD buff revert: range: 500 → 400.
 Pandemonium CR per deployment: 25% → 22.5%. Daily CR recovery: 2% → 3%.
 QOL and AI improvements to the Virtuous, Versant, Rime, Warlust, and Calm.
 Weapons
 Thrush: damage 750 → 700, refire 9 → 10 seconds, regeneration 0.13334 → 0.06667/s, durability 300 → 150, and Micro-Missiles per warhead 7 → 5.
 Plover durability: 100 → 200 HP.
 Bugfixes & QC
 Added Diable to the refit-screen simulator.
 Fixed several sound, compatibility, and drop issues.
 Have fun 🙂
changelog.3.0.3:
SAVE COMPATIBLE
detailed patch notes still available in the link in the OP
 Bugfixes & QC
 Updated 62 outdated or incorrect variants.
 Fixed Gulf weapon-group saving, XO chatter visibility, and several recovery/drop issues.
 Deep Strike Conversion can no longer be S-modded.
 Diable Aesthetics now properly overrides Advanced Avionics trails.
 Coupled Lazyhorns are no longer obtainable outside the Storm.
 Ships & Logistics
 Improved Grazer charge awareness and disengaged movement.
 Buffed Chinook fuel and Stratus cargo capacity.
 Rime (F) now carries 550 fuel and gains an Adaptive Flight Deck: empty bays enter standby and no longer count against fleet fighter-bay limits.
 Shear deployment and recovery cost increased from 5 to 7.
 Weapons
 Fully reverted IBIS and Raptor to Tartiflette’s firing profile. Their magazines now last considerably longer in echange for lower intial burst.
 Banish Torpedoes buff/bugfixed to 2,000 damage/EMP to match tooltip, with faster aiming and punchier launch sequence. Their hidden non-ECCM accuracy penalty is gone.
 Versant Burst mode reduced from 900 to 600 combined DPS, restoring a clearer distinction between its three firing modes.
 Cleaned up Micromissile reload statistics.
 Pandemonium Micromissile magazine reverted from 300 to 20 with no loss of sustained fire.
 Added clearer Deep Strike Catapult role and reload information.
 Made the Plover slightly easier to hear in combat.
 Hullmods & Codex
 Wanzer Servicing Gantries can no longer be S-modded. Doesn't fit the balancing after buffs
 Updated Codex integration to modern vanilla conventions, including discoverable blueprint packages, encounter unlocks, named built-ins, and properly hidden module entries.
 Crossmod Support
 Added tailored Second In Command support to the Dead Frequency boss encounter.
 Reduced Virtuous minimum crew from 30 to 20 for Arma Armatura players.
 TriOS compat improved
